hints.title: Signed Rational Term Extraction
hints.text: Every fraction term in the string begins with an explicit or implicit sign, followed by a numerator, slash, and denominator.

hints.title: Running Rational Accumulator
hints.text: Maintain running numerator A and denominator B initialized to 0/1. For each next term a/b, update A = A * b + a * B and B = B * b.

hints.title: Greatest Common Divisor Reduction
hints.text: After adding all terms, reduce the rational by dividing both numerator and denominator by gcd(abs(A), B), ensuring positive denominator.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
import math
import re

class Solution:
    def fractionAddition(self, expression: str) -> str:
        tokens = re.findall(r"[+-]?\d+/\d+", expression)
        num, den = 0, 1
        for tok in tokens:
            n, d = map(int, tok.split("/"))
            num = num * d + n * den
            den = den * d
        g = math.gcd(abs(num), den)
        return f"{num // g}/{den // g}"
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Floating point evaluation accumulates rounding errors, failing strict exact fraction tests.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Exact rational arithmetic maintains integer numerators and denominators, simplifying with gcd.

import re

        num, den = 0, 1
